title: dryopteris papuae-novae-guineae
intro: Dryopteris papuae-novae-guineae, commonly known as New Guinea shield fern, is a species of fern native to Papua New Guinea. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris papuae-novae-guineae include its use as an anti-asthmatic, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
